title: WPSS/1577/2012 of SUDHA SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No.1577 of 2012
Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, J.
None is present for the petitioner.
Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, Brief Holder for the
State.
The Court itself has gone through the
pleadings.
Petitioner participated in the selection process
for filling upon the post of Assistant Teacher (Home
Science). She did not possess the essential educational
qualification prescribed under the Recruitment and
Promotion Rules.
Petitioner obtained her requisite qualification
from Allahabad Shiksha Visarad. This qualification is
not recognized by the State of Uttarkhand.
Accordingly, there is no merit in this petition
and the same is hereby dismissed.
Pending application, if any, also stands
disposed of.
